about.p1: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a measure of body fat based on height and weight. It estimates how lean or heavy a person is, and it is a general indicator of whether their weight is healthy for their height.
about.p2: The categories used to read the number vary by region and age, and cutoffs can differ in some countries, such as those in Asia. This calculator uses the World Health Organization categories for adults and CDC growth charts for children and teens.

adult.intro: For adults aged 20 and older, BMI is read the same way for men and women, using the WHO classification.
adult.caption: BMI categories for adults

children.intro: For ages 2 to 20, BMI is not read from fixed cutoffs. It is compared with other children of the same age and sex using CDC BMI-for-age percentile charts, because body fat changes as children grow and differs between boys and girls.
children.aria: Children and teens BMI categories table
children.caption: BMI categories for children and teens

bmiUs.title: BMI, US units
bmiUs.note: Weight in pounds, height in inches.

prime.title: BMI Prime
prime.note: The ratio of your BMI to 25, the upper limit of the normal range. Below 0.74 is thin, above 1 is overweight.

ponderal.title: Ponderal Index
ponderal.note: Uses height cubed instead of squared, which is more reliable for very tall or very short people. Shown here in kg/m³.

formulas.example: Example: a person who is 5 feet 10 inches (70 inches) tall and weighs 160 lb has BMI = 703 × 160 / 70² = 22.95, which rounds to 23.0 and falls in the Normal range. In US units the Ponderal Index is written as height (in) / ∛weight (lb), the inverse form, which gives 12.9 for the same person.
formulas.healthy: The healthy weight range shown in the result is the weight that gives a BMI of 18.5 to 25 at your height. For children and teens it uses the 5th to 85th percentile BMI for their age and sex.

underItems: Developmental issues in children and teens
It can also be a sign of a condition such as anorexia nervosa

limits.p1: BMI measures weight relative to height, not body fat. It does not account for muscle mass, bone density, age, sex or activity level, so a muscular person can score as overweight while carrying little fat. For roughly 90 to 95 percent of people BMI is a fair indicator of body fat, but it should be used alongside other measures and a health professional's advice.
limits.disclaimer: This calculator is for general information only and is not medical advice.
